title: cryptoGUY
tagline: CRYPTOGUY is an AI-powered Telegram chatbot for crypto, offering real-time prices, alerts, news, and trend tracking.
description: CRYPTOGUY is an AI agent chatbot designed for cryptocurrency enthusiasts and traders. It delivers real-time crypto price updates, price alerts for sharp market changes, and breaking news that impacts the crypto industry. The bot also tracks social media trends on Twitter (X) and provides insights from top influencers like CZ, Vitalik, Elon, and Michael Saylor. By integrating with EigenLayer, CRYPTOGUY ensures verifiable AI inferences. The chatbot is deployed on the Coinbase Developer Platform and utilizes AgentKit for staking functionalities.
how_its_made: CRYPTOGUY is built using a combination of blockchain and AI-driven technologies. It is deployed on the Coinbase Developer Platform with AgentKit, enabling integration with staking features on Coinbase. The chatbot leverages EigenLayer via the @elizaos/adapter-opacity package, which implements the IVerifiableInferenceAdapter interface to ensure verifiable AI inferences. The system is designed to be highly flexible, supporting multiple AI model providers and allowing future expansion to integrate gateways via CloudFlare. Each request is customizable, and the built-in proof verification ensures transparency and security.
